name: Resolves To Target
description: A Route 53 record set resolves to a resource (record set -> Application Load Balancer, other load balancer, CloudFront distribution, or another record set in the same zone). From an alias record's AliasTarget, or from a CNAME whose value is a load balancer's or distribution's DNS name. The record names the hostname; this edge names what answers it. Replaces the zone's direct ROUTES_TRAFFIC (aws-core-tap#220).

via.description: How the record names its target: an alias (AliasTarget) or a CNAME value.

evaluate_target_health.description: An alias's EvaluateTargetHealth; null for a CNAME.
